messages:
alex: starting a tiny canary for the 'spec-horizon' peekahead on rwd-12b-4bit. routing 1% traffic, mixed gpu fleet.

marta: what's the exact peek policy? budget, trigger, fallback?

alex: trigger when surprisal_ratio > 1.1 over a 6-token window OR when topk_entropy < 0.6. peek budget = 10 tokens; acceptance uses KL threshold 0.04. If latency p95 > 260ms revert to baseline model.

sam: what quant setup? straight 4-bit qint? any per-channel scales?

alex: per-channel symmetric 4-bit with block size 64, outlier folding enabled. weights rebalanced with clipping at 0.995 quantile.

marta: eval plan? which datasets and how we're measuring per-example degradations?

alex: running: MMLU samples (200), HellaSwag small (250), GSM8K lite (100), and a retrieval-augmented dev set (400 queries). We compute per-example delta in log-likelihood for gold next token, perplexity ratio, and exact-match where applicable. Also collecting spec_accept_rate = fraction of tokens where peek accepted.

sam: share the curl so SRE can hit the route with their loadgen.

alex: curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.canary.redwood.int/v1/generate
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN'
  -d '{"model":"rwd-12b-4bit-spechz-canary","route":"canary:1%","prompt":"<PROMPT>","cfg":{"peek_policy":"spec-horizon","budget":10}}'
```

ops-bot: deploy event recorded: rwd-12b-4bit-spechz-canary -> 1% starting 1749507785. pods=6

marta: any telemetry from the first 30m? latency / errors / accept_rate?

alex: early stats: p50 105ms vs baseline 118ms, p95 245ms vs baseline 255ms. spec_accept_rate ~6.2%. CPU offload slightly higher but net cost drop ~6%. error rate 0.15% vs baseline 0.12%.

sam: quality deltas? MMLU / GSM8K / HellaSwag?

alex: MMLU micro drop 0.8% absolute, GSM8K EM -0.6%, HellaSwag -1.1%. Retrieval dev set recall unchanged. Per-example log-prob delta skewed to short-instruction prompts where peek accepted.

marta: weird that short instructions are affected; I expected longer contexts. Can we log token positions where peek triggered and bucket by prompt length?

alex: yes logging positions + token surrounding features (is_punct, is_entity). Early signal: many triggers on punctuation followed by choice lists.

sam: propose a conservative alpha variant: require seq_len>40 AND surprisal_ratio>1.25. And beta: same triggers but reduce budget to 6. Run each at 0.5% for 3h.

alex: scheduling both. Will annotate canary dashboard with per-prompt-type deltas and repetition@5. Also adding vocab_entropy curve for accepted sequences.

marta: add a small human review for 120 worst HellaSwag diffs; include reference vs generate pairs. If majority look better or equivalent, we can relax.

sam: also add a guard to not accept peeked tokens that lower gold-token logprob by >0.2 (i.e., reject acceptance if it hurts gold too much).

alex: noted. Next steps: spin alpha and beta, run full aggregations, post findings by EOD. If HellaSwag drop >1% on both variants, auto-roll back.

ops-bot: scheduled job: collect-per-example-deltas -> started 1749507810 (job-id 4721).

marta: thanks. ping here when alpha/beta up. keep it tight on traffic.

alex: will do. quick note: recording raw decoded beams for 1% of peeked events to inspect failure modes offline.

sam: :thumbsup:
